results.content:
Based on 816 reviews

Review OpenAI?

Reviewers largely see OpenAI as a strong, practical platform: they praise fast, reliable models, solid APIs, clear docs, and broad use across coding, writing, research, automation, image work, and agents. Makers of Product Hunt, Lovable, and Warp say their products run key features on OpenAI models, reinforcing its production credibility. The main complaints are familiar: high or unpredictable costs, rate limits, short context or weak long-term memory, and some answers that feel generic or miss the point.

results.title: Z.ai Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
What I appreciate most is that the team decided to open-source such a capable model. The AI community benefits enormously when high-quality foundation models are openly available, and I wanted to leave a review simply to thank and recognize the work that went into this release.

Looking forward to seeing how the project evolves.

#### What needs improvement

The model is already very capable. My main suggestion would be to continue improving stability and reducing occasional errors during long-running agentic workflows. As the ecosystem matures, even more consistency across extended coding sessions would make it an exceptional developer model.

#### vs Alternatives [...] 4.8

Based on 6 reviews

Review Z.ai?

Z.ai has received overwhelmingly positive feedback from users, who praise its impressive performance and strong capabilities in tasks like coding and creating presentations. Users highlight its potential as a leading open-source model, with some comparing it to OpenAI's offerings. The platform's ability to produce high-quality PowerPoint presentations with minimal input is particularly noted, with users appreciating the improved layout over manual efforts. Despite minor errors, the overall sentiment is that Z.ai is a powerful and recommendable tool.

I've been using GLM-5.2 extensively over the past few days, primarily for software engineering tasks through OpenCode and Hermes-Agent, and it has genuinely impressed me.

The biggest compliment I can give is that, during many coding sessions, it gave me a similar feeling to using Claude Opus. Not because the models are identical, but because of how reliably it understands context, follows complex instructions, and completes multi-step engineering tasks.

I also tested it through Ollama Cloud using an API key, and the experience was consistently solid across different environments.
